dc.description.value: Each file contains measurements of the absorption characteristics at the temperature stated in the title (e.g. file "80K_raw_data.txt" contains data collected at 80K. The files contain the following information - column 1: wavelength as measured by the spectrometer (apply an offset of -0.176 nm for calibration); column 3: power incident on the sample (multiply by a factor of 22.8 for calibration); column 4: power transmitted through the sample; column 5: sample temperature.
